//: Minds (09 §3.1), plain and generic, written as a modder would. Each says in its `doc` how a character of its kind behaves, so that a player can learn it and rely on it (09 §1). Stances come from tags a character presents and from what it was seen to do, until relations are built.
doc: An ordinary person. Goes about near home, walking a little and standing a while. Goes to look at a noise it heard and did not see, then goes back to what it was doing. Calls out and runs from danger seen or heard close by, and keeps away from anyone it saw hurt someone.

A watchman. Walks a beat near his post. Goes to look at a noise he heard and did not see. Goes for anyone he holds hostile while he can see them, and for anyone he saw hurt someone; once he has lost them, goes to where he last believed they were, looks round, and goes back to his beat.
A dog. Wanders near home and lies about. Goes to sniff at a noise it heard. Runs from anyone who hurt someone in front of it, and from what it fears.
